_privacy_note: private, unlisted or public (owner-authorized 2026-11-26, promo Shorts only). YouTube forces private until the Google Cloud project passes the YouTube API compliance audit; the queue then halts instead of posting more private Shorts.
_setup: Copy to config/promo_youtube.json and set expected_channel_id to the channel the PilotMyCareer Shorts go to (YouTube Studio > Settings > Channel > Advanced settings). It has its own Keychain sign-in (keyring_user), so it can be a different channel from the TaleNovi story queue. Then: promo_queue.py authorize, promo_queue.py next, promo_queue.py schedule-install.
